about.title: About IDEA Lab
content: AICTE IDEA (Idea, Development, Evaluation and Application) Lab is a flagship initiative of the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), designed to foster a culture of creativity, problem-solving, hands-on learning, and entrepreneurial thinking among students and faculty in engineering and technology institutions across the country.

We are delighted to share that Karpagam College of Engineering has been sanctioned an AICTE-IDEA Laboratory with a total project outlay of ₹90 lakh. The funding comprises ₹60 lakh under non-recurring grants, earmarked for state-of-the-art equipment, tools, and prototyping resources, and ₹30 lakh as recurring grants, which will support training programs, workshops, industry interactions, innovation challenges, and other activities over the next two years.

This facility will empower students and faculty to transform ideas into prototypes and solutions, encourage multidisciplinary collaboration, and contribute meaningfully to the innovation and start-up ecosystem.

vision.title: Vision
vision.content: To establish the AICTE–IDEA Lab as a vibrant centre for innovation, experiential learning, research, and entrepreneurship, enabling students and faculty to transform ideas into practical, industry-relevant and socially impactful solutions through multidisciplinary collaboration, emerging technologies, and hands-on learning.

items.title: Foster Innovation and Practical Application
items.description: Give students and faculty a space to ideate, experiment, prototype, and apply engineering knowledge to real-world problems.

items.title: Strengthen Collaboration — Industry and Multidisciplinary
items.description: Build strong ties with industry through mentoring, projects, and internships, and encourage students across disciplines to work together on shared solutions.

items.title: Promote Research, Entrepreneurship, and Start-up Culture
items.description: Help good ideas grow from concept to prototype to real-world commercialization.

items.title: Develop Competent, Responsible Professionals
items.description: Build creativity, problem-solving skills, leadership, and an entrepreneurial mind-set in students so they can contribute meaningfully to society.

items.title: Experiential Learning & Innovation
items.description: Encourage hands-on learning and creative problem-solving through prototyping and Hackathon competitions, connecting classroom theory with real practice.

items.title: Prototyping, Products & Multidisciplinary Innovation
items.description: Turn ideas into working prototypes and products using modern tools and technology, with students from different branches collaborating on integrated solutions.

items.title: Industry Collaboration & Industry-Ready Competencies
items.description: Partner with industry on real projects while building students' technical and soft skills such as communication, teamwork and leadership, along with exposure to IoT, AI, robotics and automation.

items.title: Entrepreneurship, Research & Intellectual Property
items.description: Support students and faculty in building start-ups, filing patents, and conducting research that solves real problems.

items.title: Societal Impact & Sustainable Innovation Ecosystem
items.description: Develop affordable and sustainable technologies for healthcare, agriculture, energy and rural needs while building a lasting culture of innovation through regular workshops, events and mentoring.
